name: gert-preview
description: Preview gert runbooks (.runbook.yaml) as a structural graph in VS Code.

gert.packageMap.markdownDescription: Path to the package-map file passed to `gert serve --package-map`. Absolute or relative to the active runbook's project root (resolved via `pickServerRoot`, never `workspaceFolders[0]`). Leave empty to fall back to the project-root convention (`package-map.yaml`). If neither the setting path nor the convention file exists, `--package-map` is omitted.

gert.mcpBridge.toolNameOverrides.markdownDescription: Override the registered MCP tool name for a logical `tool/action` key. Use this to correct a name mismatch in a live session without a code change or release. Example: `{ "tsg-recommendation/recommend": "my-org-tsg-recommend" }`

gert.binaryPath.description: Path to the gert CLI binary used for offline previews.

gert.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the gert server. If autoStartServer is true and this is left at the default, the extension picks a free port and ignores this value.

gert.autoStartServer.description: If true, the extension spawns `gert serve` automatically when you run a graph preview. Set to false to use an external server (configure gert.serverUrl).

scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && vscode-test
scripts.package:clean: rm -rf out && npm run compile && npm run package
